ext.description: Universal real-time agent dashboard for Claude Code: auto-setup hooks, per-project agent view, real subscription plan limits
view.dashboard.name: Dashboard
cmd.openInEditor: Claude Office: Open Dashboard in Editor
cmd.emergencyStop: Claude Office: Emergency Stop / Resume Agents
cmd.installHooks: Claude Office: Install Claude Code Hooks
cfg.language: Dashboard UI language. "system" follows the OS language even when VSCode itself runs in English.
cfg.hooks.autoSetup: Offer to install Claude Code hooks automatically when they are missing, and keep hook scripts up to date
cfg.statusBar.enabled: Show a status bar item with agent activity; turns into a warning when Claude is waiting for your input
cfg.roster.enabled: Discover agents from the project's .claude/agents/ folder and show them as idle immediately
cfg.usage.enabled: Show plan usage panel (real subscription limits via your Claude Code login)
cfg.usage.costSource: Additional cost-estimate bars (USD). "ccusage" spawns `npx ccusage` periodically
cfg.usage.limitBlockUsd: Block limit USD (only for the ccusage cost bars)
cfg.usage.limitWeeklyUsd: Weekly limit USD (only for the ccusage cost bars)
cfg.usage.limitWeeklyOpusUsd: Opus weekly limit USD (only for the ccusage cost bars)
cfg.scope: workspace = this window only; global = all Claude Code sessions
cfg.agentRooms:
Custom agent→room mapping. Merged **over** the built-in defaults. Example: `{"my-custom-agent": "backend", "design-agent": "frontend"}`.

Known rooms: `directors`, `backend`, `frontend`, `qa`, `security`, `devops`, `integrations`, `ai-lab`, `iot`, `lobby`.

Unknown agents are resolved by a keyword heuristic (e.g. `*-director` → directors, `react-*` → frontend); unmatched agents fall back to `lobby`.
